Kelime Tahmin nasıl oynanır: How to play Turkish Word Guess
Amacın gizli 5 harfli Türkçe kelimeyi en: This is a Turkish word game: your goal is to find the hidden 5-letter Turkish word in at most 6 tries. Type a real 5-letter Turkish word with your keyboard or the on-screen keys and press Enter. After each guess the letters change color: green means the letter is in the word and in the right spot, yellow means it's in the word but somewhere else, and gray means it isn't in the word at all. Use these hints to narrow down your next guess. Find the word within 6 tries to win; otherwise the hidden word is revealed
Tahminin kelime listesinde yoksa ya da 5: If your guess isn't in the word list or has fewer than 5 letters, the row shakes and you don't lose a try. If a letter appears only once in the word, only one square is colored and any extras show gray. The on-screen keys are colored with the best information you've found. The game saves after every guess, so you can close the page and continue later. In daily mode everyone solves the same word, and you can share your result as colored squares without giving away the letters
<strong>Klavye:</strong> harf tuşlarıyla: Keyboard: type with the letter keys (including the Turkish Ç, Ğ, I, İ, Ö, Ş, Ü; lowercase i becomes İ), delete with Backspace and submit with Enter.
İlk tahminde A, E, İ, R, L, K, N gibi Tü: For your first guess, pick a word with no repeated letters that uses letters common in Turkish, like A, E, İ, R, L, K, N. Don't reuse gray letters; the on-screen keyboard dims them. Move a yellow letter to a different spot in your next guess to find where it belongs. Hidden words never end in suffixes like -LAR or -LER because they're all plain roots, so focus on the root's vowel harmony, not the ending. Remember a letter can appear twice
<strong>Kelimeler ekli mi?</strong> Hayı: Do the words have suffixes? No, hidden words are plain roots. You can still use words with suffixes in your guesses.
<strong>Günlük kelime ne zaman değişir?<: When does the daily word change? A new daily word arrives every day at midnight (Turkey time).
<strong>Zor mod nedir?</strong> Bulduğun: What is hard mode? In hard mode you must use the green and yellow letters you've found in every later guess. Green letters stay in place and yellow letters must appear in the guess. Hard mode is chosen before the game starts and keeps its own record.
<strong>Yüksek kontrast ne işe yarar?</s: What does high contrast do? For players who find colors hard to tell apart, it turns green into orange and yellow into blue.
